Legends meet again! DreamWorks How to Train Your
Dragon skins are coming soon!

New hero skins are here! Valka takes on the role of
the Shadow Priest, bridging the mystical bond
between dragons and humans to protect the balance
of their world! Valka, embodying both compassion
and strength, is brought to life directly from the
beloved DreamWorks How to Train Your Dragon
universe. Unlock her exclusive skin now! 

Upgrade the skin to unlock mesmerizing visual
transformations—Valka will soar into battle on the
back of Cloudjumper, her loyal and majestic
Stormcutter companion! Witness this graceful duo
gliding through the skies, their unity and wisdom
striking awe into friend and foe alike. Don’t miss your
chance to bring this legendary pair into your
collection and lead your team with Valka’s inspiring
presence! 

✅ Event Start Date: 19th October, 2026 
✅ Opening Server: 10001-10764
